john.17.p1.b1.text: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said,

john.17.p1.b2.text: Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.

john.17.p1.b3.text: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.

john.17.p2.b1.text: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.

john.17.p2.b2.text: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.

john.17.p3.b1.text: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world.

john.17.p3.b2.text: They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.

john.17.p3.b3.text: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You …

john.17.p4.b1.text: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.

john.17.p4.b2.text: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You.

john.17.p4.b3.text: Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.

john.17.p5.b1.text: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me.

john.17.p5.b2.text: Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.

john.17.p5.b3.text: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.

john.17.p6.b1.text: … the world has hated them; for they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

john.17.p6.b2.text: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.

john.17.p7.b1.text: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.

john.17.p7.b2.text: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.

john.17.p7.b3.text: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.

john.17.p8.b1.text: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,

john.17.p8.b2.text: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.

john.17.p9.b1.text: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—

john.17.p9.b2.text: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united …

john.17.p9.b3.text: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me

john.17.p9.b4.text: … because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.

john.17.p10.b1.text: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.

john.17.p10.b2.text: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known,

john.17.p10.b3.text: so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.
